name: Teyrnon

attributes.attribute: slashed the claw that carried the stolen child

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Teyrnon is a Welsh hero. He appears in the story of Rhiannon and her son Pryderi. He is the foster father of Pryderi. One night, on Beltane, a huge claw came down from the sky. It aimed at a newborn foal. Teyrnon rushed to defend the foal. He slashed at the claw. The claw dropped the thing it carried. That thing was a stolen child. Teyrnon and his wife brought up the child as their own. That child grew to be Pryderi.

okr.objective: Tell the story of Teyrnon rescuing the stolen child Pokud.
